subject: Request: short-term ramp sponsorship for POC latency/throughput run
messages:
From: Samir Gupta <samir@brightcart.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short window request — POC ramp (latency & throughput validation)

Alex,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BrightCart's infra team and ML folks are aligned and we'd like to run a focused 72-hour ramp to validate our integration with Redwood. High level:

- Goal: sustain a 1,200 qps steady state with short bursts up to ~6k qps for 10–15 minute windows to validate autoscale and p95 latency under load.
- Target SLO: p95 < 200ms for our inference calls (payloads ~1.2k tokens).
- Window: proposed July 5 00:00 UTC — July 8 00:00 UTC (72 hours).
- Telemetry: we'll push traces and request IDs; we need access to token-level cost and per-route latency buckets during the run.
- Ask: temporary promotional credits and a short-lived sandbox with elevated concurrency (or an ephemeral Dedicated slot) for the window.

Attached is our test plan and traffic model (BrightCart_POC_plan.pdf). Two quick questions for you: approx how many promo tokens/voucher would you recommend for this workload, and can you put limits such that credits only apply to the test window?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — aim to finalize infra next week.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Head of Infrastructure
BrightCart
Attachment: BrightCart_POC_plan.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short window request — POC ramp (latency & throughput validation)

Samir —

Appreciate the clarity. A few quick clarifications before we size this:

1) Are the 1.2k qps sustained with average token output per call ~1.2k tokens, or is that the request size? Helps with token accounting.
2) Is the burst pattern predictable (scheduled ramp) or random traffic?
3) Any compliance constraints (log retention, region pinning) we should enforce on the sandbox?

Prelim estimate: for the window you describe I'd propose a one-off promotional credit plus a targeted sandbox uplift. Ballpark voucher: $3k–$5k equivalent (we usually translate to ~300k–500k token buffer depending on model choices). If you can accept a small telemetry hook (request_id + route tag) we can limit usage to the test and produce a scoped usage report.

I've attached a short mutual action plan template for us to align on milestones and responsibilities — fill the left column and I'll route the approval internally.

Attachment: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

If you confirm the burst cadence and the token sizing I'll kick off an approval request with our sales ops team.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-27T13:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Short window request — POC ramp (latency & throughput validation) — internal approval request

Alex / Ben — forwarding Samir's ask. Quick summary in case you don't have time to open the attachment: brightcart wants a 72h ramp with 1.2k steady qps and bursts to 6k qps. They want credits scoped to the window plus telemetry access.

Estimate from Alex: $3k–$5k voucher (300k–500k token buffer). I'm requesting sign-off for a $4k promotional credit + a sandbox uplift (ephemeral concurrency bump) conditioned on:

- Credits expire 2026-07-09 00:00 UTC (grace day after test).
- Telemetry tag required for attribution.
- Usage cap and automated shutoff if sustained >120% of forecast for 30m.

I've attached the formal approval packet for finance ops. Approve/adjust and I'll notify Samir.

Attachment: approval_request.pdf (application/pdf)

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-28T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Short window request — POC ramp (latency & throughput validation) — internal approval request

Marissa —

Approve the one-off $4k promo credit and sandbox uplift. A few conditions:

- Credit only usable between 2026-07-05 00:00 UTC and 2026-07-09 00:00 UTC.
- Limit credit redemption to the BrightCart account and to routes matching /api/infer and /api/batch-infer.
- Require telemetry tag "brightcart-poc-3421" in every request for attribution and to auto-generate the post-run report.
- If usage exceeds 120% of forecast for more than 30 minutes, auto-disable the uplift and notify account team.

Alex — can you draft the short amendment and the voucher code with these guardrails? I'll log a one-time promotional ledger entry under BR-3421. Add the HubSpot ticket and the MMP link in the message to the customer.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Growth, Redwood Inference
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/BR-3421

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@brightcart.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short window request — POC ramp (latency & throughput validation) — approved

Samir — good news: we approved a one-time promotional package for BrightCart. Summary and next steps:

- Promo credit: $4,000 equivalent (voucher: BR-3421-PROMO-4K) scoped to BrightCart account only.
- Effective window: 2026-07-05 00:00 UTC — 2026-07-09 00:00 UTC (includes a one-day grace period).
- Route restriction: only requests tagged to /api/infer and /api/batch-infer will draw on the voucher.
- Telemetry: please include header x-rdwd-tag: brightcart-poc-3421 in every request. We'll use that to produce the post-run token & latency report.
- Autosafety: uplift will be automatically paused if actual traffic >120% of forecast for 30+ minutes; ops will notify you and the account team.

Attachments: trial_credit_proposal.pdf (proposal with voucher code and guardrails), provision_log.txt (provisioning notes — voucher created and sandbox uplift scheduled).

Next steps for you:
1) Sign the mutual action plan (I've attached the MMP link and a template I shared earlier): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1exampleMMP/view
2) Confirm the expected token size per request and the exact burst cadence (scheduled vs random).
3) Share the point-of-contact for the run (Slack handle preferred) so our on-call can be looped.

If you confirm items 2 and 3 by EOD Friday we'll finalize infra and post the voucher.

Happy to jump on a quick 20-minute sync if helpful.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: trial_credit_proposal.pdf (application/pdf), provision_log.txt (text/plain)
